fav.chooseImportable: Choose a favorite (internet radio or TuneIn).
fav.willSave: Will be saved as a stream scene: {uri}
fav.willSaveFavorite: Will be saved as a Sonos favorite (plays via TuneIn) — don't rename it in the Sonos app.
group.msgDissolve: “{name}” leads the group. The whole group is ungrouped: {others} become standalone and silent, “{name}” keeps playing alone.
group.msgLeave: “{name}” leaves the group of “{coordinator}” and goes silent. The other speakers keep playing.
log.infoFile: Newest first. Also saved on the NAS (data volume, folder logs). Contains no access keys.
log.infoMemory: Newest first, since the last start. Contains no access keys.
log.loadFailed: The log could not be loaded.
log.title: Log
members.none: No speakers found — refresh speakers first.
np.title: Now Playing
radio.hits: {n} results — tap one to pick the station.
radio.noToken: Token missing — use “Change API token” in the Speakers tab.
scene.favOnlyNew: Favorite import only when creating — choose a custom URL or a speaker.
scene.idHint: Generated from the name; fixed when editing.
scene.idSlug: The ID must be a slug (a-z, 0-9, hyphen).
scene.label: Scene
scene.name: Name
scene.stationMissing: Station missing — search and tap a result.
scene.uriMissing: Stream URI missing — choose a speaker with a playing stream or enter a URL.
scenes.namesNotInDiscovery: Scene names not in discovery: {names} — use names exactly as in the Sonos app.
schedule.empty: No schedules yet — tap + at the top right (e.g. Mon–Fri 06:10).
schedule.tzHint: Without a stop time the scene keeps playing; it is only stopped if the scene itself is still playing.
setup.blocked.alreadySetUp.text: Someone has already created the access key. Continue and enter the key. If that was not you, see “If something doesn't work” in the guide.
setup.blocked.alreadySetUp.title: Already set up
setup.blocked.expired.text: For your security, setup is only possible during the first hour after Hallido starts. Restart the Hallido container in Container Manager or Container Station, then reload this page.
setup.blocked.expired.title: Setup time is over
setup.blocked.notLocal.text: Set up Hallido from a phone or computer in your home network, using the address of your NAS (for example http://192.168.1.20:8790) – not through a remote-access service.
setup.blocked.notLocal.title: Only from your home network
setup.blocked.unavailable.text: Hallido does not answer as expected. Check that the container is running, then try again.
setup.blocked.unavailable.title: Setup not available
setup.done.text: Next, create your first scene: a radio station on one or more speakers. A schedule then turns a scene into a wake-up alarm (tab “Schedules”).
setup.done.title: Hallido is ready
setup.error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
setup.error.network: Hallido cannot be reached. Is the container running?
setup.speakers.none: No speakers found yet. Are they switched on and in the same network as the NAS? You can continue and search again later in the “Speakers” tab.
setup.speakers.text: Hallido looks for Sonos speakers in your home network.
setup.speakers.title: Find speakers
setup.token.keep: Keep it safe, for example in your password manager or on paper next to your NAS. Never share it publicly.
setup.token.saved: I have saved the access key
setup.token.text: This key is shown only now. This browser remembers it. On other phones or computers, enter it once under Speakers → Change API token.
setup.token.title: Your access key
setup.welcome.key: First, Hallido creates a personal access key. Only devices that know this key can operate Hallido.
setup.welcome.text: Hallido plays radio on your Sonos speakers – as groups, at the push of a button or as a wake-up alarm. Setup takes about two minutes.
setup.welcome.title: Welcome to Hallido

source.notIntegratable: No direct stream — please enter a custom URL
speakers.listFailed: Could not load the speaker list.
speakers.noneToSave: No speakers to save — refresh first.
token.info: Stored locally in the browser and sent as a bearer token.
